grf.observed_reality: Current main still uses final-component-only grant-state path rejection. PR736 adds static ancestor checks but explicitly leaves post-check path-component replacement unresolved. PR742 preserves a descriptor-relative candidate but is closed because opening it queued forbidden legacy VPS/self-hosted workflows.
grf.generated_reality: A userspace path-lineage precheck can be correct at validation time yet stale before the authority-changing grant write if an ancestor component is replaced.
grf.counter_reality: Rechecking symlink ancestry before mkdir/write is sufficient to prevent redirection without descriptor anchoring.
grf.falsifier: Validate a legitimate state path with the static candidate, then rename its ancestor and replace that pathname with a symlink before continuing the grant write.
grf.collapse: The static-precheck-only candidate redirected the write and is REFUTED as sufficient for this TOCTOU world. Descriptor-relative anchoring survived the same treatment arm in the active sandbox and is retained as the stronger candidate mechanism, not yet product-accepted.
